value.acceptance: A PDF SOP becomes a PDDL procedure draft with capability and job drafts.
An OWL/Turtle file becomes a knowledge pack bound by knowledge_pack_ref.
BPMN, Visio and draw.io become PDDL procedure drafts.
Publication needs a human approval; the drafting job cannot publish.
A re-ingest creates a new draft version; the published row keeps its source and pack.
A bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source cannot bind.
